messages:
alex: Quick sync — final draft of the release notes is in Google (link in doc). Need two quick decisions before I lock: 1) which model to pin for Dedicated (v2.3.1 vs v2.4-beta), 2) internal announce timing across timezones. Can folks review by EOD PST?

maria: skimmed and pushed a few edits. main ask: explicit rollback criteria + canary % (I put a suggestion: canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 1h). also added a short note about metric thresholds.

sam (oncall): main ops concern — prefer pin v2.3.1 for Dedicated. v2.4-beta is fine as a hosted fallback but don't mix pin versions in the same region. if we must, document the routing policy. tagging @jamie-ops for capacity check.

jamie: Agree with sam. Also propose we include the timezone matrix in the RN so comms know exact send windows. Suggest announce windows: NA 18:00 PST, EU 02:00 GMT, APAC 10:00 SGT (these are relative; doc has the matrix).

jamie: Also, deploy-bot cue I plan to use:```
deploybot schedule --release v2.3.1 --canary 5% --time 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z --announce internal
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jamie: release=v2.3.1, canary=5% at 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z UTC. Canary watch: 30m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 1s during first 30m.

alex: thanks — I'll update the RN to pin v2.3.1 for Dedicated, note v2.4-beta as hosted fallback, and add the timezone matrix table + the rollback bullets. Maria — can you own canary monitoring? Sam — will you be oncall for the window?

maria: I can own the canary watch. Added alert playbook to the doc (alerts, dashboard urls, runbook steps). :white_check_mark:

liyah: quick legal/marketing note — EU legal asked for a one-line reminder about PII handling in the external blurb. I added: "No PII will be logged or included in shared examples." Also, can we delay the external public blast by +30m after internal to avoid noisy signals?

alex: good catch. shifting external by +30m works. I'll update the header and send schedule.

sam (oncall): I'll be oncall and watching. If we hit rollback, I'll create a short incident thread in #incidents with root cause and rollback reason.

jamie: one last thing — can someone confirm Dedicated capacity pinning is operational? I did a dry-run of the pin command in staging and it succeeded but want an ops + infra thumbs.

maria: infra thumbs from me — saw no errors in dry-run logs.

alex: great. final action items: alex update RN and push pinned matrix; maria owns canary; sam oncall; jamie runs deploybot schedule at T-30m; liyah adjusts legal copy and external +30m. If anyone finds a critical wording change, comment in the doc; otherwise I'll lock by 17:30 PST. :rocket:
